protocol: 50 claims sampled seed-17 from 1,106 live post-veto rows (20 shards, 400 AI/ML papers); graded by the session model vs FULL abstracts BEFORE ingest/scoring; labels frozen at write time. DEFECT threshold (fixed before grading, applied uniformly): (a) asserts what the abstract does not — contamination, misattribution, strength escalation; (b) drops a condition/qualifier that changes truth conditions; (c) turns on a method named nowhere in the statement AND carries no 'The paper ...' frame to resolve the referent. NOT counted as defects: missing attribution frame where the artifact is named; 'The paper achieves X' with the system unnamed (page provenance resolves it); kind-field mislabels.

defect_notes.6: 'The approach offers flexibility...' — dangling 'The approach', no paper frame; subject 'matrix completion' is the broader class the problem falls within, not the method
defect_notes.7: drops 'In the discrete setting' — concentration results hold only there; claim reads as unconditional
defect_notes.11: binds the general 'couple of bits per trainable parameter' finding to 'Qwen2.5 fine-tuning'; the abstract attaches Qwen2.5 to the separate privacy-leakage result
defect_notes.12: drops 'when the index appears at the end of the input' — load-bearing: the abstract explicitly contrasts the index-at-beginning case where small RNNs succeed in 1 layer
defect_notes.24: '+0.020' with neither its metric (WSS@95%) nor its topic (Statins); number uninterpretable as stored
defect_notes.31: cross-paper contamination: Rust-vs-Python circuitry claim on an autonomous-vehicle coordination paper (MAPS); same family as the vetoed LoRA-NSGDM row
defect_notes.36: abstract 'suggest ... more distinct responsibilities' rendered under a 'shows' frame
defect_notes.43: 'The framework is applied to...' — dangling 'The framework', HTb named nowhere in the statement
defect_notes.47: 'absent from baselines' broadens the abstract's 'absent from LLM-only baselines'
